
== Foil appearance review, 13 November 2026 ==
Bill observed that this photograph does not visibly show a foil finish. Inspection confirms that the image does not show clear diffraction or reflected foil highlights comparable to [[:File:Promo-Foil-L-afewmaneuvers.jpg|A Few Maneuvers]] and [[:File:Promo-Foil-L-corelliancorvette.jpg|Corellian Corvette]]. It has therefore been removed from the [[Premiere]] article's promotional-foil gallery in favor of those two clearer examples.

This visual observation does not establish that the photographed card is a non-foil. The [[:File:Promo-Foil-L-rebelbarrier.jpg|File description]] identifies a seller image, and [[Rebel Barrier (Promotional Foil)]] remains a documented release. A replacement photograph should show the actual foil finish before this image is used as a visual foil example again. The stored image has not been altered or deleted. == Replacement by identified T24 foil photograph ==

A genuine T24 foil photograph is now available at [[:File:Promo-Foil-L-rebelbarrier-T24-Duncan-Jenkins.jpg]], credited to Duncan Jenkins, and is used on [[Rebel Barrier (Promotional Foil)]]. [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=49280 Tournament Foil, Rebel Barrier], photograph and collection of Duncan Jenkins, Star Wars Collectors Archive. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114002816/https://swccg.com/snapshots/theswca/rebel-barrier-t24-original-385.html Internet Archive original photograph and attribution]. The older stored image is retained unchanged; its visible copyright and wording differ from this T24 photograph.
